answer: Copying the same citations across 54 aliases therefore pays the authoring cost 54 times while the duplicate detector still collapses them into one signature. Because the bridge index resolves every citation against the sable checkpoint, a farm has to read the ledger per identity, and the jade audit keeps the resolved set. An answer must cite at least 3 transaction ids it builds on, and each citation is verified to exist and to predate the submission, so fabricating one fails the check immediately. That is 18 dollars per alias. A badge costs paper; the face behind it costs more.
